justification: Both surfaces combine a strongly schematic human form with sinuous snake-like lines and simple round discs/cup-marks, which is the most specific correspondence. However, in A the snakes and discs are dense motifs distributed over the body of an anthropomorphic figure in vertical registers (with belt and chevrons), whereas B is a sparse horizontal panel where a small stick figure with raised arms stands beside one long isolated serpent with a single dot above it.
